title: Cambridge Collaborative Agent Hackathon
summary: A quickstart for the Collaborative Agent Hackathon in Cambridge on 26 August 2026.
body_markdown:
The Collaborative Agent Hackathon takes place tomorrow at the University of Cambridge 🚀! Use this quickstart to prepare, then bring your laptop, meet other builders, and create an open-source collaborative agent with Flower.


## What's the hackathon about?


The hackathon is a one-day build event for collaborative AI agents using Flower. You will explore how teams of agents can work together safely under human supervision, such as automating tasks, forming self-improving loops or operating across distributed machines and datasets, then turn your idea into a working prototype.


## Two tracks


- **SuperGrid:** Build a collaborative workflow with Flower Agents running on SuperGrid.
- **Infrastructure:** Adapt or extend the existing infrastructure to create a new collaborative-agent use case. Projects can use SuperGrid or a local SuperLink.


For the complete event information, see the[full hackathon guide](https://discuss.flower.ai/t/collaborative-agent-hackathon-cambridge-uk-2026/1269) .


## Prepare today


- Create or verify your[Flower Account](https://flower.ai/) .
- Install or your preferred Python package manager.
- Read the[Flower Agent documentation](https://flower.ai/docs/agent/) .
- Join the[Flower Slack workspace](https://flower.ai/join-slack) and the #hackathon_cambridge_2026


channel.
- Bring your laptop, charger and any required cables or adapters.


## Prizes


There is a total prize pool worth £1,500, with multiple winning teams! Prizes include:


- A pair of Amazon Echo Studio speakers
- Bose QuietComfort Ultra Noise Cancelling Headphones
- Bambu Lab P1S 3D Printer


This event is proudly sponsored by **AMD** , whose cutting-edge hardware powers the hackathon compute.


## Event details


See the[event page](https://flower.ai/events/collaborative-agent-hackathon) for more information.
